statements:
CREATE TABLE asset_assignments (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assigned_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	returned_at DATETIME, 
	notes TEXT, 
	assigned_by INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE asset_categories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	icon VARCHAR, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	custom_field_schema JSON, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE assets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_tag VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	serial_number VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	purchase_date DATE, 
	purchase_price FLOAT, 
	warranty_expiry DATE, 
	vendor_id INTEGER, 
	location_id INTEGER, 
	department_id INTEGER, 
	assigned_to INTEGER, 
	notes TEXT, 
	custom_fields JSON, 
	qr_code_path VARCHAR, 
	image_path VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES asset_categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_to) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES locations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	changes JSON, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	user_name VARCHAR, 
	ip_address VARCHAR, 
	timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE certificates (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR, 
	issued_date DATE, 
	expiry_date DATE, 
	cert_type VARCHAR, 
	auto_renew BOOLEAN, 
	registrar VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE cloud_subscriptions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR, 
	"plan" VARCHAR, 
	billing_cycle VARCHAR, 
	monthly_cost FLOAT, 
	renewal_date DATE, 
	auto_renew BOOLEAN, 
	account_url VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE consumable_stocks (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	qty_in_stock INTEGER, 
	min_stock_level INTEGER, 
	unit VARCHAR, 
	last_restock_date DATE, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE consumable_transactions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	consumable_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	qty_change INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	transaction_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	date DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(consumable_id) REFERENCES consumable_stocks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE departments (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR, 
	manager VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name), 
	UNIQUE (code)
)

CREATE TABLE ip_addresses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	address VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subnet VARCHAR, 
	gateway VARCHAR, 
	dns_primary VARCHAR, 
	dns_secondary VARCHAR, 
	vlan VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE locations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR, 
	parent_id INTEGER, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES locations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE maintenance_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maintenance_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	cost FLOAT, 
	scheduled_date DATE, 
	completed_date DATE, 
	vendor_id INTEGER, 
	technician VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors (id)
)

CREATE TABLE network_ports (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	panel_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	port_number VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	connected_asset_id INTEGER, 
	cable_type VARCHAR, 
	vlan VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	location_id INTEGER, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connected_asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES locations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR, 
	entity_id INTEGER, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR, 
	due_date DATE, 
	is_read BOOLEAN, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE rack_units (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rack_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	start_unit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	end_unit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER, 
	position VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rack_id) REFERENCES racks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE racks (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	location_id INTEGER, 
	total_units INTEGER, 
	power_capacity FLOAT, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES locations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE software_licenses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	license_key VARCHAR, 
	license_type VARCHAR, 
	seats_total INTEGER, 
	seats_used INTEGER, 
	expiry_date DATE, 
	vendor_id INTEGER, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	authentik_id VARCHAR, 
	email VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	avatar_url VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (authentik_id)
)

CREATE TABLE vendors (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	contact_person VARCHAR, 
	email VARCHAR, 
	phone VARCHAR, 
	website VARCHAR, 
	contract_info VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_asset_categories_slug ON asset_categories (slug)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_assets_asset_tag ON assets (asset_tag)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_ip_addresses_address ON ip_addresses (address)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)
